doc.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Upcoming trio, duo and solo projects
summary: He describes trio tours with Buster Williams and Matt Wilson, duets with David Grisman, and solo concerts.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: That’s fascinating. What’s in the near future for you music-wise. I know you’re working with Patrick.

Yeah that’s one project that’s going on. I’ve got a number of trio performances coming up in the next year, most of them will be with Buster Williams on bass and Matt Wilson on drums. I’ve been really enjoying playing with them. I’ve got two CDs in the can from our last performance at the Jazz Bakery last fall, and I’m currently trying to market those. And I’ve got a couple of labels that seem quite interested and hopefully that’ll be out
before too long. I will be doing another west coast tour with Matt and Buster in the fall. In January I’ll be at the IAJE convention with them.
